description: cmix v21 forced text-mode wrapper using a vendored binary patched to file-back large adaptive tables through mmap. The binary and english.dic are gzip-compressed and counted toward program_size.
hypothesis: The unrestricted cmix v21 -t archive is below 10.95 percent; if the same predictor can run with resident RAM below the Hutter ceiling by moving large tables to temporary files, it becomes the strongest known constructive frontier program.
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
POSIX mmap and temporary filesystem space
verdict: Unmeasured. This is the current strongest frontier candidate because it targets the known sub-10.95 cmix21 text-mode archive while addressing the Hutter memory constraint.
